phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ إنَّ أَحَداً لاَ يَبْلُغُ مِنْ شُكْرِكَ غَايَةً
phrases.english: 1.O God, no one reaches a limit in thanking You

phrases.arabic: إلاّ حَصَلَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ إحْسَانِكَ مَا يُلْزِمُهُ شُكْرَاً،
phrases.english: 2.without acquiring that of Your beneficence which enjoins upon him thanksgiving,

phrases.arabic: وَلا يَبْلُغُ مَبْلَغاً مِنْ طَاعَتِكَ وَإن اجْتَهَدَ
phrases.english: 3.nor does anyone reach a degree in obeying You, even if he strives,

phrases.arabic: إلاَّ كَانَ مُقَصِّراً دُونَ اسْتِحْقَاقِكَ بِفَضْلِكَ،
phrases.english: 4.without falling short of what You deservest because of Your bounty.

phrases.arabic: فَأَشْكَرُ عِبَادِكَ عَاجِزٌ عَنْ شُكْرِكَ
phrases.english: 5.The most thankful of Your servants has not the capacity to thank You,

phrases.arabic: وَأَعْبَدُهُمْ مُقَصِّرٌ عَنْ طَاعَتِكَ،
phrases.english: 6.and the most worshipful of them falls short of obeying You.

phrases.arabic: لا يَجبُ لأِحَد أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لَهُ بِاسْتِحْقَاقِهِ،
phrases.english: 7.To none of them is due Your forgiveness through what he himself deserves

phrases.arabic: وَلا أَنْ تَرْضَى عَنْهُ بِاسْتِيجَابِهِ،
phrases.english: 8.or Your good pleasure for his own merit.

phrases.arabic: فَمَنْ غَفَرْتَ لَهُ فَبِطَولِكَ،
phrases.english: 9.When You forgivest someone, it is through Your graciousness,

phrases.arabic: وَمَنْ رَضِيْتَ عَنْهُ فَبِفَضْلِكَ
phrases.english: 10.and when You art pleased with someone, it is through Your bounty.

phrases.arabic: تَشْكُرُ يَسِيرَ مَا شُكِرْتَهُ وَتُثِيبُ عَلَى قَلِيلِ مَا تُطَاعُ فِيهِ
phrases.english: 11.You showest gratitude for the paltry for which gratitude is shown to You and You rewardest the small act in which You art obeyed,

phrases.arabic: حَتَّى كَأَنَّ شُكْـرَ عِبَادِكَ الَّذِيْ أَوْجَبْتَ  عَلَيْهِ ثَوَابَهُمْ
phrases.english: 12.so that it seems as if Your servants' thanksgiving for which You hast made incumbent their reward

phrases.arabic: وَأَعْظَمْتَ عَنْهُ جَزَاءَهُمْ
phrases.english: 13.and made great their repayment

phrases.arabic: أَمْرٌ مَلَكُوا اسْتِطَاعَةَ الامْتِنَاعِ مِنْهُ دُونَكَ
phrases.english: 14.is an affair from which they could have held back without You,

phrases.arabic: فَكَافَيْتَهُمْ أَوْ  لَمْ يَكُنْ سَبَبُهُ بِيَدِكَ فَجَازَيْتَهُمْ،
phrases.english: 15.and hence You wilt recompense them, and whose cause is not in Your hand, and hence You wilt repay them.

phrases.arabic: بَـلْ مَلَكْتَ يَا إلهِي أَمْرَهُمْ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَمْلِكُوا عِبَادَتَكَ،
phrases.english: 16.Nay, my God, You hadst power over their affair before they had power to worship You,

phrases.arabic: وَأَعْدَدْتَ ثَوَابَهُمْ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُفِيضُوا فِي طَاعَتِكَ،
phrases.english: 17.and You hadst prepared their reward before they began to obey You;

phrases.arabic: وَذَلِكَ أَنَّ سُنَّتَكَ الأِفْضَالُ،
phrases.english: 18.and that because Your wont is bestowal of bounty,

phrases.arabic: وَعَادَتَكَ الإحْسَانُ، وَسَبِيلَكَ الْعَفْوُ،
phrases.english: 19.Your custom beneficence, Your way pardon.

phrases.arabic: فَكُلُّ الْبَرِيِّةِ مًعْتَرِفَةٌ بِأَنَّكَ غَيْرُ ظَالِم لِمَنْ عَاقَبْتَ،
phrases.english: 20.So all creatures confess that You wrongest not him whom You punishest

phrases.arabic: وَشَاهِدَةٌ بِأَنَّكَ مُتَفَضِّلٌ عَلَى مَنْ عَافَيْتَ،
phrases.english: 21.and bear witness that You bestowest bounty upon him whom You pardonest.

phrases.arabic: وَكُلٌّ مُقِرٌّ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالتَّقْصِيْرِ عَمَّا اسْتَوْجَبْتَ،
phrases.english: 22.Each admits that he has fallen short of what You meritest.

phrases.arabic: فَلَوْلا أَنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَخْتَدِعُهُمْ عَنْ طَاعَتِكَ ما عَصاكَ عاصٍ
phrases.english: 23.Had Satan not misled them from Your obedience, no disobeyer would have disobeyed You,

phrases.arabic: وَلَوْلا أَنَّهُ صَوَّرَ لَهُمُ البَاطِلَ فِي مِثَالِ الْحَقِّ
phrases.english: 24.and had he not shown falsehood to them in the likeness of truth

phrases.arabic: مَا ضَلَّ عَنْ  طَرِيْقِكَ ضَالٌّ.
phrases.english: 25.no strayer would have gone astray from Your path.

phrases.arabic: فَسُبْحَانَكَ مَا أَبْيَنَ كَرَمَكَ
phrases.english: 26.So glory be to You! How manifest is Your generosity

phrases.arabic: فِي مُعَامَلَةِ مَنْ أَطَاعَكَ أَوْ عَصَاكَ،
phrases.english: 27.in dealing with him who obeys or disobeys You!

phrases.arabic: تَشْكُرُ للْمُطِيْعِ مَا أَنْتَ تَوَلَّيْتَهُ لَهُ،
phrases.english: 28.You showest gratitude to the obedient for that which You undertakest for him,

phrases.arabic: وَتُمْلِي لِلْعَاصِي فِيْمَا تَمْلِكُ مُعَاجَلَتَهُ فِيْهِ،
phrases.english: 29.and You grantest a respite to the disobedient in that within which You art able to hurry him.

phrases.arabic: أَعْطَيْتَ كُلاًّ مِنْهُمَا مَا لَمْ يَجِبْ لَهُ،
phrases.english: 30.You givest to each of them that which is not his due,

phrases.arabic: وَتَفَضَّلْتَ عَلَى كُلٍّ مِنْهُمَا بِمَا يَقْصُرُ عَمَلُهُ عَنْهُ
phrases.english: 31.and You bestowest bounty upon each in that wherein his works fall short.

phrases.arabic: وَلَوْ كَافَأْتَ الْمُطِيعَ عَلَى مَا أَنْتَ تَوَلَّيْتَهُ
phrases.english: 32.Wert You to counterbalance for the obedient servant that which You Yourself hadst undertaken,

phrases.arabic: لاَوْشَكَ أَنْ يَفْقِدَ ثَوَابَكَ،
phrases.english: 33.he would be on the point of losing Your reward

phrases.arabic: وَأَنْ تَزُولَ عَنْهُ نِعْمَتُكَ
phrases.english: 34.and seeing the end of Your favour,

phrases.arabic: وَلكِنَّكَ بِكَرَمِكَ جَازَيْتَهُ
phrases.english: 35.but through Your generosity You hast repaid him

phrases.arabic: عَلَى الْمُدَّةِ الْقَصِيرَةِ الفَانِيَةِ بِالْمُدَّةِ الطَّوِيلَةِ الْخَالِدَةِ،
phrases.english: 36.for a short, perishing term with a long, everlasting term,

phrases.arabic: وَعَلَى الْغَايَةِ الْقَرِيبَةِ الزَّائِلَةِ بِالْغايَةِ الْمَدِيدَةِ الْبَاقِيَةِ،
phrases.english: 37.and for a near, vanishing limit with an extended, abiding limit.

phrases.arabic: ثُمَّ لَمْ تَسُمْهُ الْقِصَاصَ فِيمَا أَكَلَ مِنْ رِزْقِكَ
phrases.english: 38.Then You dost not visit him with a settling of accounts for Your provision

phrases.arabic: الَّذِي يَقْوَى بِهِ عَلَى طَاعَتِكَ،
phrases.english: 39.through which he gained strength to obey You,

phrases.arabic: وَلَـمْ تَحْمِلْهُ عَلَى  الْمُنَاقَشَاتِ فِي الآلاتِ
phrases.english: 40.nor dost You force him to make reckonings for the organs

phrases.arabic: الَّتِي تَسَبَّبَ بِاسْتِعْمَالِهَا إلَى مَغْفِـرَتِكَ،
phrases.english: 41.he employed to find the means to Your forgiveness.

phrases.arabic: وَلَـوْ فَعَلْتَ ذلِكَ بِهِ
phrases.english: 42.Wert You to do that to him,

phrases.arabic: لَذَهَبَ بِجَمِيْعِ مَا كَدَحَ لَهُ
phrases.english: 43.it would take away everything for which he had laboured

phrases.arabic: وَجُمْلَةِ مَا سَعَى فِيهِ،
phrases.english: 44.and all wherein he had exerted himself

phrases.arabic: جَزَاءً لِلصُّغْرى مِنْ أَيادِيْكَ وَمِنَنِكَ،
phrases.english: 45.as repayment for the smallest of Your benefits and kindnesses,

phrases.arabic: وَلَبَقِيَ رَهيناً  بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ بِسَائِرِ نِعَمِكَ
phrases.english: 46.and he would remain hostage before You for Your other favours.

phrases.arabic: فَمَتَى كَانَ يَسْتَحِقُّ شَيْئاً مِنْ ثَوَابِكَ ، لا ، مَتَى؟.
phrases.english: 47.So how can he deserve something of Your reward? Indeed, how?

phrases.arabic: هَذَا يا إلهِي حَالُ مَنْ أَطَاعَكَ وَسَبِيلُ مَنْ تَعَبَّدَ لَكَ،
phrases.english: 48.This, my God, is the state of him who obeys You and the path of him who worships You.

phrases.arabic: فَأَمَّا الْعَاصِيْ أَمْرَكَ وَالْمُوَاقِـعُ نَهْيَكَ
phrases.english: 49.But as for him who disobeys Your command and goes against Your prohibition,

phrases.arabic: فَلَمْ تُعَاجِلْهُ بِنَقِمَتِكَ لِكَيْ يَسْتَبْدِلَ بِحَالِهِ فِي مَعْصِيَتِكَ
phrases.english: 50.You dost not hurry him to Your vengeance, so that he may seek to replace his state in disobeying You

phrases.arabic: حَالَ الاِنَابَـةِ إلَى طَـاعَتِـكَ،
phrases.english: 51.with the state of turning back to obey You,

phrases.arabic: وَلَقَـدْ كَـانَ يَسْتَحِقُّ فِي أَوَّلِ مَـا هَمَّ بِعِصْيَانِكَ
phrases.english: 52.though he deserved from the time he set out to disobey You

phrases.arabic: كُلَّ مَا أَعْدَدْتَ لِجَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ مِنْ عُقُوبَتِكَ،
phrases.english: 53.every punishment which You hast prepared for all Your creatures.

phrases.arabic: فَجَمِيعُ مَا أَخَّرْتَ عَنْهُ  مِنْ الْعَذَابِ،
phrases.english: 54.Through each chastisement which You hast kept back from him

phrases.arabic: وَأَبْطَأتَ بِهِ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ سَطَوَاتِ النَّقِمَةِ وَالْعِقَابِ تَرْكٌ مِنْ حَقِّكَ،
phrases.english: 55.and each penalty of Your vengeance and Your punishment which You hast delayed from him, You hast refrained from Your right

phrases.arabic: وَرِضىً بِدُونِ وَاجِبِكَ،
phrases.english: 56.and shown good pleasure in place of what You hast made obligatory.

phrases.arabic: فَمَنْ أكْرَمُ  يَا إلهِي مِنْكَ
phrases.english: 57.So who is more generous, my God, than Thou?

phrases.arabic: وَمَنْ أَشْقَى مِمَّنْ هَلَكَ عَلَيْـكَ، لا ، مَنْ؟
phrases.english: 58.And who is more wretched than he who perishes in spite of You? Indeed, who?

phrases.arabic: فَتَبَارَكْتَ أَنْ تُوصَفَ إلاّ بِالإحْسَانِ،
phrases.english: 59.You art too blessed to be described by any but beneficence

phrases.arabic: وَكَـرُمْتَ أَنْ يُخَافَ مِنْكَ إلاّ الْعَدْلُ،
phrases.english: 60.and too generous for any but justice to be feared from You!

phrases.arabic: لا يُخْشَى جَوْرُكَ عَلَى  مَنْ عَصَاكَ،
phrases.english: 61.There is no dread that You wilt be unjust toward him who disobeys You,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ يُخَافُ إغْفَالُكَ ثَوَابَ مَنْ أَرْضَاكَ.
phrases.english: 62.nor any fear of Your neglecting to reward him who satisfies You.

phrases.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَهَبْ لِيْ أَمَلِي،
phrases.english: 63.So bless Muhammad and his Household, give me my hope,

phrases.arabic: وَزِدْنِي مِنْ هُدَاكَ
phrases.english: 64.and increase me in that of Your guidance

phrases.arabic: مَا أَصِلُ بِهِ إلَى التَّوْفِيقِ فِي عَمَلِي،
phrases.english: 65.through which I may be successful in my works!

phrases.arabic: إنَّكَ مَنَّانٌ كَرِيمٌ.
phrases.english: 66.Surely You art All-kind, Generous.
